plugins.name: sitespeak-chatbot-manager
plugins.description: Inspect, optimize, configure, and triage your SiteSpeak chatbots in plain English. Analytics-driven, and it confirms before every change.

skills.name: sitespeak-chatbot-manager
skills.description: Use when the user wants to inspect, optimize, configure, or triage a SiteSpeak chatbot - "look at my chatbot's analytics and optimize it for X" (more leads, better answers, smoother onboarding, human handoff, happier customers, fewer support tickets, more signups), change the model or prompts, manage knowledge sources, suggested messages, lead capture or escalations, read captured leads, or work the inbox. Connects to the SiteSpeak management MCP.
headings: Worked example: "optimize my bot for lead capture over the last quarter"
skills.description_zh: 通过 SiteSpeak 管理 MCP 检查、优化、配置和分流聊天机器人，涵盖分析、模型提示、知识来源、建议消息、线索采集、人工升级、已采集线索及收件箱。适用于改善回答、转化、接入体验和支持表现。
